_comment: Draft for THIS box (4x MI50 32GB gfx906, 125 GiB RAM, ROCm 7.2.0), written 2026-10-18 before any GLM boot - see docs/gfx906/GLM-FIRST-BOOT.md. Paths are the /ai/models/hf.co layout; Maya-L 4-shard first file; sizes are first guesses pending the first boot. 2026-10-22 (post-P4.2): --vram-margin 2.0 -> 4.0 - the chunk-MMQ c_stage staging is TWO device halves of max(1024 MiB, blob) allocated AFTER the auto expert slots, and margin 2.0 OOM'd there in every smoke (logs/p4.2-base-20261022-063849.log); margin 4.0 is the witnessed-green serve/boot number (logs/p4.2-base-20261022-180307.log, rc=0, 2.57 tok/s decode). 2026-10-23 (issue #32): 4.0 -> 5.0 - a budget-cancel serve request reaches its wrap-up prefill, which is the FIRST chunk-MMQ execution of a serve session (18-token exact-route prefill and B=1 decode both bypass that path), and that first run asks for the whole MMQ scratch set at once: c_stage 2 x max(1024 MiB, blob) = 2.002 GiB (tools/ds4/ds4_moe.cpp c_stage alloc) plus the m_* block (m_gu 256 + m_h 128 + m_g/m_u/m_d 36.02 each + m_bnd + m_iota, ~492 MiB at cap 16384) plus the m_xd side of the same set, a ~2.57 GiB burst. At margin 4.0 the steady-state layout leaves ~2.51 GiB free, so the last allocation in the chain is refused: /tmp/strata-glm-mayal-906.log lines 39-40 (reuse lcp=146 hist=146 snap=18 prompt=163 -> reused=146, then ds4_moe: m_xd: out of memory) and the ASan line 104 of the same log: allocator is trying to allocate 0x2404800 bytes = 37767168 B = 36.02 MiB, exactly the size of one q8 buffer at that cap (verified by computing mmq::q8_bytes for this cap; the whole scratch set adds up to ~2.49 GiB, close to the ~2.57 GiB the VRAM curve showed - see docs/gfx906/P4.3-serve-stop-analysis.md section 6). Reproduced 3x on a clean boot; the same request with finish=length (no cancel, so no wrap-up) and the -n 64 smoke both survive at 4.0 because neither runs the MMQ path. Margin 5.0 raises the reserve above the 2.57 GiB burst; it is the workaround, not the fix (the fix is pre-allocating the MMQ set at load). Witnessed at 5.0 on this box: /tmp/strata-glm-mayal-906.log boot 2026-10-23 08:31:38 (lines 151-172) served the same budget-cancel request to completion (32-token think, cancel, wrap-up prefill of 67 tokens with 50 reused, then 6 tokens and stop) with no m_xd refusal; slots auto gave 18.89 GiB of expert slots at margin 5.00 vs 19.89 at margin 4.00. That boot also showed the finish_reason defect analysed in docs/gfx906/P4.3-serve-stop-analysis.md (engine stop, HTTP length).
